name: DTI Excellence Rule
description: IF DTI is excellent AND limit_ratio is NOT excessive THEN score is excellent
_note: Reduced weight - DTI alone should not dominate

name: High DTI Risk Rule
description: IF DTI is high AND utilization is high THEN score is poor

name: Critical DTI Rule
description: IF DTI is critical THEN score is very_poor

name: Clean Payment History Rule
description: IF delinquency is clean AND history is mature THEN score is excellent

name: Serious Delinquency Rule
description: IF delinquency is serious OR delinquency is severe THEN score is very_poor

name: Minor Delinquency Warning Rule
description: IF delinquency is minor THEN score is fair

name: Employment Stability Rule
description: IF employment is very_stable AND income is good THEN score is good

name: Thin Credit File Rule
description: IF history is thin AND employment is unstable THEN score is poor

name: Conservative Request Rule
description: IF limit_ratio is conservative AND DTI is good THEN score is good

name: Excessive Request Warning Rule
description: IF limit_ratio is excessive THEN score is fair (compound check handles decline)
_note: Reduced weight - compound affordability check in policy layer handles hard decline

name: Stretched Request Warning Rule
description: IF limit_ratio is stretched THEN score is fair

name: High Utilization Warning Rule
description: IF utilization is high THEN score is fair

name: Critical Utilization Rule
description: IF utilization is critical THEN score is poor

name: Delinquency Plus High Utilization Rule
description: IF delinquency is minor AND utilization is high THEN score is poor

name: Good DTI With High Request Rule
description: IF DTI is excellent AND limit_ratio is stretched THEN score is fair (not decline)
_note: Compound affordability check handles final decision

name: Prime Applicant Rule
description: IF DTI is excellent AND utilization is excellent AND delinquency is clean THEN score is excellent

name: Balanced Profile Rule
description: IF DTI is moderate AND utilization is good AND delinquency is clean THEN score is fair

name: Ideal Applicant Rule
description: IF DTI is excellent AND utilization is excellent AND delinquency is clean AND limit_ratio is conservative THEN score is excellent

name: Mature Prime Rule
description: IF age is prime AND history is mature THEN score is excellent

name: Ultra-Stable Income Rule
description: IF income is high AND employment is very_stable THEN score is excellent

name: Low Income Risk Rule
description: IF income is low THEN score is fair
